description: Initial RoboDog software-only motion envelope. Do not write these values to servo EEPROM. Every command is relative to the user-confirmed neutral pose in neutral_pose.json.
notes: The 5-degree envelope is temporary and intentionally conservative.
Servo EEPROM angle limits remain unchanged.
The servos were subsequently centered at physical neutral (nominal raw 2048); see neutral_pose.json and servo_centering_log.json.

Observed 2026-10-24: front-left hip roll at +25 degrees with hip pitch and knee held near neutral causes the hip-pitch links to contact the frame and lifts the knee. This is a coupled-pose collision, so broad independent joint limits are unsafe.

pose_dependent_contact_limits.scope: Only for the tested front-left hip-pitch/knee pose; do not apply as a universal hardware limit.

temporary_joint_limit_overrides_degrees.basis: Measured first contact at +19.5 degrees; 2-degree safety margin applied.
Collision direction is negative raw motion. User reports the positive/raw-right direction has 90 degrees of clear manual travel; powered validation remains pending.

Measured frame contact at +129.7 degrees / 3524 ticks; 2-degree inward safety margin applied. A powered return toward 2048 on 2026-10-24 entered overload protection (status 32) at 3372 ticks. A user-authorized forced-direction return using goal-position bit 15 also entered overload protection at 3374 ticks. A later direct move from 1879 to 2048 instead moved to 1570 without an overload flag, confirming that the physical direction is not consistent with the current absolute-position mapping. Direct ID 2 commands are disabled pending a reviewed coordinated trajectory.
Measured cable tension at -100.5 degrees / 905 ticks; 5-degree inward cable-strain margin applied.

manual_limit_observations.status: Frame contact; temporary enforced maximum is +127.7 degrees / 3501 ticks.
Cable tension; temporary enforced minimum is -95.45 degrees / 962 ticks.
